name: frank-grimes
description: A clinical falsification loop that finds terminal flaws in code, architecture, and designs, then verifies the repairs.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial review until confidence is earned.
interface.longDescription: Grind code, architecture, plans, or designs through an evidence-first falsification review. Report flaws or fix them, re-test the affected surface, and stop only at an explicit GREEN, YELLOW, or RED verdict.
defaultPrompt: Use $frank-grimes to grind my recent changes in report mode.
